Great experience!  Both doctors studied and practiced dentistry in the USA America, and speak perfectly relaxed conversational English.

Beautiful, clean, professional office.  Very comforting service from the moment I entered the office.

Though I originally visited for a standard dental cleaning, it was easy to confirm the doctors were highly skilled and wonderfully helpful and compassionate with managing pain (I have sensitive teeth).

The doctors quickly earned my trust and respect.  Since the first dental cleaning, I elected to have Zoom teeth whitening treatment.  Very effective! I am so happy!

I am also very pleased with the doctors fixing my dental bridge.

Subsequently, I visited the Dr "Bo", the periodontist to discuss how to improve my periodontal health (receding gums, making my teeth feel painfully sensitive).

After his careful examination, rather than trying to sell me on expensive procedures, he provided practical advice about changing my brushing habits.  Weeks later, his specific advice proved to be very helpful.  For the first time in years, my gums feel healthier, and less sensitive.

Prices are reasonable.  Quality of care is exceptionally great.  Both doctors (owners of the dental practice) have garnered my trust.  Absolutely wonderful!

The office accepts credit card.

There is a dedicated, free parking lot. Easy!
Googled to get my teeth cleaned here before leaving Chiangmai in a minute. We finally found our regular dental place. Service was excellent. Dentists were friendly and great consultants. 👍 …

Best dental experience ever! Did a filing and cleaning in no time, high quality service, English speaking doctor, beautiful facilities and really reasonable prices. All my work was 1800 thb for a filling and cleaning. Highly recommended. And I just walked in and was able to be seen.
